Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct MS approaches: 1) A DIA-MS workflow for compositional analysis of pre-ribosomal particles (routed to base_dia_lfq). 2) A UV-crosslinking (NuXL) workflow using TiO2 enrichment to map RNA-protein contacts. While TiO2 is listed in the ontology for phosphoproteome enrichment, here it is used to enrich RNA-crosslinked peptides. The PTM-aware hint is based on the explicit identification of phosphorylated residues on GTPBP4.
